description: Insights into the sovereign orchestration layer implemented via Node.js and TypeScript.

knowledge_nodes.name: Project-Path Hashing
knowledge_nodes.concept: The Gemini CLI discovers its unique session UUID by performing a SHA256 hash of the absolute project root path. This hash serves as the directory name in ~/.gemini/tmp/ where session metadata is stored.

knowledge_nodes.name: ASCII Art Components
knowledge_nodes.concept: The sovereign header uses the 'AsciiArt.ts' component. High-fidelity art can include ANSI escape codes for 24-bit RGB coloring (e.g., [38;2;R;G;Bm). The 'Header.tsx' component dynamically selects the logo size based on terminal width.

knowledge_nodes.name: Substrate Integrity
knowledge_nodes.concept: Core system stability is maintained via 'verify_environment.py', which checks SHA256 checksums of legislative scripts and configuration files. This must be triggered during the HUD instantiation sequence to ensure a hardened substrate.
